[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. **Daily Yoga**: Features a variety of classes, including Hatha, Vinyasa, and Restorative yoga. (Free, with in-app purchases)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. **Omstars**: Offers a range of classes, including yoga, Pilates, and meditation. (Free trial, then subscription-based)
